requested_by: 동동 (2026-11-18): 일봉 전저점·전고점 분할 물타기(ADR 0088)에 손절만 넣어서 다시 테스트
reading: Entry rule, add rule, tranche size, leverage 5, target +10% from average, 60-day timeout, 5-day cooldown and universe are exactly ADR 0088 (prereg dca-extreme-prereg-v1). Only a stop rule is added. The exit mode 'target_time_only' (no stop) of ADR 0088 is the control; the ADR 0088 structural stop L0*(1-s*(K+1)) is a second reference. Reference runs reproduce ADR 0088 numbers and are NOT new trials.

data.source: same as ADR 0088: project upload alts_2021_2026_binance_um_15m_funding.zip, 17 USDT-M alts, daily bars from 15m UTC
data.btc_eth: not in the upload; not used

stop_rules.avg_close: daily close <= avg*(1-x) (short: >= avg*(1+x)) -> exit signal, fill next open (gap risk included)
stop_rules.avg_intra: the day's low (short: high) reaches avg*(1-x) -> exit the same day at the stop price; if the open already gapped beyond it, fill at the open (no slippage in the main row)
stop_rules.last_close: daily close <= last_tranche_fill*(1-w) (short mirror), last tranche = the most recent fill (first entry when no add yet) -> exit signal, fill next open
stop_rules.last_intra: same level as last_close but triggered intraday at the stop price, gap -> open
stop_rules.liquidation_precedence: if the stop price is farther from the open than the liquidation price (avg*(1-1/5+0.005)) liquidation happens first; a gap open beyond liquidation is liquidated (loses margin only, ADR 0088 rule)
stop_rules.reentry: after any stop the cycle ends and the ADR 0088 5-day cooldown applies, then the normal entry rule may open a new cycle (whipsaw re-entry is part of the result)

k0_controls_with_stop.note: single tranche W; last_* equals avg_* when K=0 so not repeated

references_not_counted.note: reproduce ADR 0088 results; their trials were counted in ADR 0088

fixed.cost: measured alt cost PE-ed757f47 per fill and per exit; volume_scaled, x2, assumed v1 and cost0 reported

grid.context: ALT17-1d-scalein-v1 (same symbol set as ADR 0088; trials added to the same ADR 0087 context)

robustness_reported_not_gated.intra_stop_slippage: intraday-stop configs re-run with an extra 0.5% adverse fill slippage on the stop fill (not new trials)
robustness_reported_not_gated.stop_vs_control: per base/N: change vs the no-stop control in S1/S2 Sharpe, mean/median cycle net bp, liquidated share, envelope drawdown, worst cycle
robustness_reported_not_gated.stop_exit_share: share of cycles ended by stop, and mean net bp of stopped cycles

judgement_dev_only.a: S1 annualised Sharpe (measured cost, constant capital 1) > expected max under N=52 (and cumulative N)
judgement_dev_only.g_tail: S1 and S2 intraday-envelope max drawdown <= 0.20 of capital AND liquidated cycles <= 5% of cycles
judgement_dev_only.h_stop_value: report (not gate): whether the stop lowers liquidated share and envelope drawdown, and whether S1/S2 Sharpe rises vs the no-stop control

note: Any change of stop levels, a, W, target, timeout, leverage, universe is a new prereg and new trials.
